CHEMISTRY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S? (1 mark)

   C. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.0: INORGANIC CHEMISTRY Strand S.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
